name: Hime Dorei ~Mesu e to Ochiyuku Futago no Oujo~
original_name: 姫奴隷～牝へと堕ちゆく双子の王女～
source:
There is the Luvence Kingdom in the northern part of continent, which takes full control of the region. The king has beautiful twin sisters, Tita and Liese. And he decides to give Tita the heir to the throne. Liese gets so mad to hear that, and starts to hate Tita. One day, a man, Waldo, comes to the kingdom. He is a magician, and his country was destroyed by the Luvence army. His purpose is to take revenge on them. Waldo and Liese meet by chance. A man who plans to take revenge on the kingdom and a girl who hates Tita.... Their revenge just begins.... 

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
大陆北部有一个完全掌控该地区的鲁文斯王国。国王有一对美丽的双胞胎姐妹——蒂塔和莉泽。他决定将王位继承权交给蒂塔。莉泽得知后极为愤怒，开始憎恨蒂塔。某天，一个名叫瓦尔多的男人来到了王国。他是一名魔法师，他的国家被鲁文斯军队摧毁了。他的目的是复仇。瓦尔多和莉泽偶然相遇。一个计划向王国复仇的男人和一个憎恨蒂塔的女孩……他们的复仇就此开始……

[引自ErogeShop]
